latestVersion.changelog:
AI Video Subtitle Generator — version 1.0.0

- Initial public release.
- Upload MP4, MOV, AVI, or WebM video files (up to 500MB) and generate AI-powered subtitles, supporting multi-language and auto-sync.
- All processing is cloud-based with quick 30–60 second turnaround for short clips; files exported as 1080p MP4 by default.
- Anonymous or token-based usage supported; integrates session management and credit tracking.
- User-friendly, chat-driven workflow with intelligent prompt-to-action routing for uploads, exports, credits, and timeline reviews.
